I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, so the loop now makes about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's 5/s limit. The interval is a `REQUEST_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file. I haven't run the test, since it calls the live sandbox.

I also saved a note in EngramDB about the sandbox's 5 req/s limit, so later integration tests that loop over sandbox calls get throttled too.

If CI still flakes, other tests running in parallel may be sharing the same limit. A sleep inside this one test wouldn't cover that.
